chapter: Brass bands, Buddy Petit and horns
title: Joe Petit: where he lived and how he played
summary: Where the Petits lived, Joe Petit as a valve trombonist, his hearing and teeth, and his eating habits.

blocks.x: Now, where did Buddy Petit lived in those days? Huh? Where did Buddy Petit lived? On Durdinie.
On Durdinie.
Durdinie.
Durdinie. He always lived up. He was on Durdinie.
That's where old Joe Petit lived, about that same place, across from Artisan Hall. I know Joe Petit lived there.
He lived there, across the street. That's why Joe lived where on the last time when you knew him.
Yeah.

He was on the house back there. And after he bought a other one, after that he bought a other one, Joe, he said, he was around the corner from me, right around the corner. He had a little house. he wasn't good as Joe though. Joe was one of the best in

the city. Best in the city. Had the worst horn in the city. He had the all over the world. He could see bubbles. Blowing bubbles. Coming out that horn, something coming out. Where was the last you brought a horn?
